name: UpperTheory.V.PropA.exists_centres_level
source: theorem exists_centres_level {R c : ℕ} (γ : Module.End ℤ_[l] X) {u : ℤ_[l]} (hX : GenBy l R X) (hu : IsLevel l u c) (j : ℕ) :
∃ s : Fin R → ℤ_[l], ∀ e : ℕ, twLen γ u e j ≤ ∑ i, (((j + c : ℕ) : ℕ∞) + vl l (s i - e)) := by
obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := lift l X R (γ ^ l ^ j) hX
obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := detBound l u c hu j R S
have hpow : (u ^ e • γ) ^ l ^ j = (u ^ l ^ j) ^ e • γ ^ l ^ j := by
show cokLen ((u ^ e • γ) ^ l ^ j - 1) ≤ _
show: Fix a layer j and a ℤℓ-linear endomorphism γ of a module generated by R elements. If u ∈ ℤℓ has level c, then there are R centres sᵢ ∈ ℤℓ such that the twisted length at (e,j) is at most Σᵢ(j + c + vℓ(sᵢ − e)) for every natural e.
strategy: Lift the ℓʲth power of γ to a matrix on the free presentation and apply its determinant estimate.

steps.claim: Fix j and lift γ^(ℓ^j) through the given surjection ℤℓ^R → X to an R by R matrix S. For every scalar a its lift bounds the cokernel length of aγ^(ℓ^j) − 1 by vℓ(det(aS − I)). The matrix determinant estimate supplies R integral centres for this S simultaneously for all natural e.
steps.snippet:
∃ s : Fin R → ℤ_[l], ∀ e : ℕ, twLen γ u e j ≤ ∑ i, (((j + c : ℕ) : ℕ∞) + vl l (s i - e)) := by
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := lift l X R (γ ^ l ^ j) hX
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := detBound l u c hu j R S
  refine ⟨s, fun e => ?_⟩

steps.claim: Scalar multiplication commutes with endomorphism powers, and eℓ^j = ℓ^j e. Thus (u^eγ)^(ℓ^j) = (u^(ℓ^j))^e γ^(ℓ^j).
steps.snippet:
have hpow : (u ^ e • γ) ^ l ^ j = (u ^ l ^ j) ^ e • γ ^ l ^ j := by
    rw [smul_pow, ← pow_mul, ← pow_mul, mul_comm]
steps.typedFact: (u ^ e • γ) ^ l ^ j = (u ^ l ^ j) ^ e • γ ^ l ^ j

steps.claim: By definition the twisted length at (e,j) is the length of the cokernel of (u^eγ)^(ℓ^j) − 1. This is the length to be bounded by Σᵢ(j + c + vℓ(sᵢ − e)).
steps.snippet: show cokLen ((u ^ e • γ) ^ l ^ j - 1) ≤ _

steps.claim: Substitute a = (u^(ℓ^j))^e in the lifted cokernel bound, then use the determinant estimate for aS − I. This gives twLen(e,j) ≤ Σᵢ(j + c + vℓ(sᵢ − e)). If a centre equals e its summand is infinite. For R = 0 the free source is zero, so X is zero and the bound is the empty sum zero.

chapterTitle: Twisted cokernels in a cyclotomic tower
